source.title: Blizzard World of Warcraft hotfixes — March 13, 2026, Items section
source.author: Blizzard Entertainment

quote: Gear obtained at levels 10-79 disenchants into The War Within materials.
notes: Official rolling hotfix article's March 13, 2026 section specifically limits this to gear from newly created Crate of Battlefield Goods. The same note states gear obtained at levels 80-90 yields Midnight materials. This identifies the DESTROY OUTPUT EXPANSION for that award-level/provenance context only; exact crate/reward gear itemIDs, bonus IDs, rarity, slot, item-level versions, observed casts, per-output units, hits, zero outcomes, skill/spec and output item ranks are all unknown. Do not extrapolate to unrelated level 10-79 gear, old crate contents or all TWW gear. Independently corroborated by Warcraft Wiki's dated hotfix patch-change entry. Evidence is a Blizzard eligibility/rate-epoch note, NOT a player study or numerical yield estimate. No prospect/mill effects implied.
affects: Gear from newly created Crate of Battlefield Goods: acquisition level 10-79 -> The War Within materials; 80-90 -> Midnight materials. Exact input item IDs unknown; applies to the specific crate generation context, not all gear of those levels.
wording: Gear obtained at levels 10-79 disenchants into The War Within materials.
